name: 15101 · Allison Park, PA
findings: ZIP 15101 (Allison Park) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15101 (Allison Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
